answer: Because selection is random and the thread seed is unrevealed until close, an adversary cannot dodge the sample, so colluding to grade clones' junk is a gale gamble with a negative expected value. The garden log keeps the sampled set and the penalty so the deterrent is verifiable. A random sample of settled verdicts is re-graded by an independent panel each epoch, and a divergence found on re-check costs the original grader 27% of its standing plus a seat ban. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
